name: UNIV 3294
title: Entrepreneurial Approaches to Community-Centered Innovation
description: Foundational knowledge necessary for involvement in multi-semester experiential learning programs on current/emerging topics of general interest to the University community. Open to all students following a successful application. May be repeated for credit with a change in topic, up to a total of six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor consent; enrollment in this course is through application and is open to undergraduate students of any major at UConn.
